visual.general_description: Two side-by-side color photographs of an infant's skin and scalp, with no printed letters, labels, arrows or scale. The left photograph is a close-up of a skin surface with a large area of dark purple-black and olive-brown discoloration on red skin; the right photograph shows an infant's back, scalp and ear with smaller gray-brown patches.
visual.detailed_description: Left photograph: a close-up of reddened skin. A large rounded area of dark purple-black discoloration with a lighter olive-brown zone above it sits in the center, with thin dark ink lines along parts of its margin. A small raised pink-white nodule with a small reddish center lies in the middle of the dark area. Light gray gloved fingers hold the infant at the upper left and the right edge, white cloth lies at the lower left, and a thin white lead runs to a round cream-colored disc at the lower right. At the far right of this photograph there is white gauze or tape with a yellow connector and green wires beside a small finger-like shape. Right photograph: the back of the head with dark hair, one ear with a white adhesive pad behind it, and the upper and mid back with red skin. A vertical dark ink line runs down the middle of the back, with a few small gray-brown patches along it in the upper back and a larger gray-brown patch with a dark ink outline in the lower part of the frame. Pale dry flaking skin is visible at the left edge of the back. A gloved hand and part of a blue cap are visible at the right edge. The face is not visible in either photograph, and no printed text or patient identifiers are visible.
